title: ERC-735 Claim Holder proposed as a GitHub issue
detail: Fabian Vogelsteller opens ethereum/EIPs issues for ERC-734 Key Manager and ERC-735 Claim Holder, the basis of ONCHAINID. Neither became an EIP file.

title: Lightning Labs starts the LSAT specification
detail: First commit of the LSAT (Lightning Service Authentication Token) repository: macaroon plus Lightning invoice behind HTTP 402.

title: ERC-3643 (T-REX) created
detail: Permissioned token standard with ONCHAINID claims; now Final.

title: LSAT renamed L402 in the Lightning Labs specification
detail: Documentation rewrite replaces LSAT with L402; both scheme names remain accepted.

title: bLIP-0026 L402 drafted
detail: Lightning Labs authors propose L402 to the Lightning bLIP process (PR #26, still open on 2026-10-11).

title: bLIP-0026 rewritten to be token-agnostic
detail: Draft adds version="0" and a generic token= parameter; macaroons become RECOMMENDED, not required. Lightning Labs' own repository text still uses macaroon=.

title: ERC-8226 Regulated Agent Mandate proposed
detail: Draft ERC from Brickken authors: scoped, time-bounded, capped agent authority over regulated tokens, naming ERC-3643 or ERC-7943 and ERC-8004 as adjacent layers.

title: Web Monetization draft republished
detail: WICG Draft Community Group Report with Interledger Foundation editors; not a W3C standard. No agent program announced.

title: ERC-8226 adds per-asset mandates
detail: Mandates keyed by agent, principal and asset (PR #2060). Still Draft.
